name: Simon Peter
overview: Simon Peter is revealed in Scripture as a foundational disciple called personally by Jesus to become a 'fisher of men,' signifying his role in the early Church. He boldly confesses Jesus as the Christ, the Son of the living God, and is named 'Peter,' meaning rock, upon whom Jesus declares He will build His Church, assuring its victory over evil. Despite this great calling, Peter faces trials and warnings, including Jesus' prediction of his testing by Satan, highlighting both his human frailty and the necessity of divine strength. His journey reflects the tension between faith and failure, culminating in a deeper understanding of Jesus' mission and suffering.
